job.title: Validation & Metrology Engineer
job.description:
Validation & Metrology Engineer
Location Westmeath
Reports To RA/QA Manager
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Validation & Metrology Engineer to join our growing Quality team in a high-precision medical device manufacturing environment. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced metrology professional to take ownership of our measurement systems, inspection technologies, and dimensional validation processes.
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing robust metrology solutions, designing inspection fixtures, programming Micro-Vu vision measurement systems using MicroView software, conducting Measurement System Analysis (MSA), and supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), validation activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
This is a highly technical position that will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, repeatability, and reliability of our inspection processes while supporting the manufacture of world-class orthopaedic medical devices.
Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and validate custom metrology and inspection fixtures for precision components.
  • Develop, optimise and maintain MicroView programs for Micro-Vu optical CMM systems.
  • Create efficient and repeatable automated inspection routines for complex machined components.
  • Lead Measurement System Analysis (MSA), including Gage R&R, bias, linearity and stability studies.
  • Perform statistical analysis using Minitab to evaluate process capability and measurement performance.
  • Interpret engineering drawings and GD&T requirements in accordance with ASME Y14.5.
  • Support First Article Inspection (FAI), process validation and new product introduction activities.
  • Develop and maintain inspection methods, work instructions and validation documentation.
  • Investigate dimensional non-conformances and support root cause investigations using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Collaborate with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering and Operations to improve inspection capability and measurement efficiency.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, metrology innovation and process optimisation.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 13485, FDA requirements and internal Quality Management System procedures.

Qualifications & Experience
Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in precision metrology or quality engineering.
  • Strong experience programming Micro-Vu systems using MicroView software.
  • Extensive knowledge of optical and tactile CMM inspection techniques.
  • Experience designing metrology and inspection fixtures.
  • Strong understanding of GD&T and dimensional analysis.
  • Practical experience conducting MSA and Gage R&R studies.
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis using Minitab.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.

Desirable

  • Experience within medical device, orthopaedic, aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing environments.
  • Orthopaedic Experience is a distinct advantage
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA Quality System requirements.
  • Experience with validation activities (IQ/OQ/PQ).
  • CAD experience, preferably SolidWorks.
  • Familiarity with additional CMM software such as PC-DMIS, Calypso or Mitutoyo MCOS.
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent qualification.

What We're Looking For
The successful candidate will be:

  • Passionate about precision measurement and continuous improvement.
  • Highly analytical with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across engineering and manufacturing teams.
  • Driven to improve measurement capability, automation and process robustness.
  • Committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality within a regulated manufacturing environment.

job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
Production Technician
Location: Shannon, Co. Clare
Salary: €45,000–€55,000
Industry: Biopharma / Manufacturing
Position type: Full-time, permanent
Role overview
The Production Technician will support day-to-day manufacturing operations, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient production of high-quality product. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience from a biopharma or regulated manufacturing environment; strong mechanical assembly experience (building and fitting parts/sub-assemblies) is highly beneficial.
Key responsibilities

  • Operate production equipment and follow batch documentation/SOPs to meet safety, quality, and output targets.
  • Perform mechanical assembly of components/sub-assemblies to defined specifications.
  • Execute routine manufacturing tasks such as material handling, line setup/changeover, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Accurately complete GMP documentation in real time.
  • Conduct in-process checks and support sampling/inspection requirements per procedure.
  • Identify and escalate deviations, equipment issues, and quality concerns; support investigations as required.
  • Support equipment cleaning, line clearance, and 5S activities to maintain a compliant and audit-ready area.
  • Assist with maintenance activities (first-line maintenance), coordinating with Engineering/Maintenance teams where needed.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives (yield, downtime, scrap reduction, cycle time improvements).
  • Adhere to EHS standards at all times, including safe systems of work and risk assessments.

Requirements

  • Experience in a production/manufacturing environment
  • Strong hands-on mechanical aptitude with proven assembly experience (parts, tools, fixtures, drawings).
  • Comfortable working to SOPs and quality standards; strong attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work as part of a shift/team environment.
  • Biopharma/pharma/medical device experience with GMP documentation.
  • Experience in cleanroom environments and good contamination control practices.
  • Experience with troubleshooting equipment
  • QQI Level 5/6, apprenticeship, or technical qualification in Engineering/Mechanical/Manufacturing (or equivalent).

job.title: Manufacturing engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer
Location: Shannon, Co. Clare
Industry: Manufacturing
Salary: 55-65k
Position type: Full-time, permanent
Role overview
The Manufacturing Engineer will support and improve day-to-day manufacturing operations, driving process stability, efficiency, quality, and cost improvement. This role partners closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and NPI teams to implement robust manufacturing processes and deliver continuous improvement initiatives.
Key responsibilities

  • Provide manufacturing engineering support to production to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations.
  • Develop, implement, and optimise manufacturing processes, work instructions, routings, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Lead continuous improvement projects (Lean / Six Sigma) focused on cycle time reduction, yield improvement, scrap reduction, and productivity gains.
  • Support equipment selection, commissioning, validation/qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ as applicable), and process capability studies.
  • Collaborate with Quality to support NCRs, CAPA, deviation investigations, and customer complaints where manufacturing input is required.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) / process transfer activities including PFMEA, control plans, line balancing, and training.
  • Ensure EHS standards are embedded into process design and daily engineering support (risk assessments, safe work practices).
  • Analyse production data and KPIs; provide reports and recommendations to improve performance and uptime.
  • Work with suppliers/contractors on tooling, fixtures, jigs, and process improvements.



Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics Engineering (or similar).
  • 3+ years’ manufacturing engineering experience in a high-volume or regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of process engineering, production support, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience in problem-solving and root cause analysis with measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specs, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to influence on the shop floor.

job.title: Equipment Submission Engineer
job.description:
Salary: €60,000–€75,000 (DOE)
Experience: 5+ years in HVAC / Building Services / Mechanical construction
Reporting to: Pre-Construction Manager
Location: Mayo


Role Summary
This role leads the technical submittal process for HVAC equipment and ductwork packages, turning design intent into procurement-ready schedules and client-approvable technical submissions. You will coordinate across design, estimating, procurement, suppliers, and site teams to ensure technical compliance, timely approvals, and smooth handover from pre-construction to delivery.



Core Responsibilities

  • Validate scope, allowances, and technical assumptions with the Estimating Team during bid and post-award phases.
  • Translate the procurement strategy into a submittal plan (packages, priorities, sequencing, long-lead items).
  • Identify technical and commercial risks early (non-compliance, missing info, programme conflicts) and escalate with solutions.
  • Build compliant submittal packs including datasheets, performance data, drawings, certifications, and technical clarifications.
  • Manage the full review cycle: internal review → vendor review → client/consultant submission → comments → resubmission → approval.
  • Ensure each submission is traceable back to the project specification and drawings, clearly calling out any deviations or alternatives.
  • Drive response timelines with vendors/consultants to keep submissions moving.
  • Interrogate design information (drawings/models/specs) and raise RFIs where gaps or clashes affect procurement or install.
  • Maintain an auditable RFI log with owners, dates, status and impact (cost/programme/technical).
  • Participate in client/consultant coordination meetings, presenting issues clearly and pushing for decisions.
  • Issue “approved for procurement” packs to the Procurement Team with clear scope, approved selections, and constraints.
  • Support purchasing by technically assessing vendor offers for compliance, lead time, access/maintenance and install requirements.
  • Provide ongoing technical support to the Site/Installation Team during installation—resolving equipment/ductwork queries and ensuring the approved solution is installed.
  • Own document control for technical submissions: revision control, transmittals, comment resolution, and approval status reporting.
  • Keep registers accurate and project-ready for audits, handover and O&M inputs.


Experience & Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years’ experience in HVAC/building services within a contractor, specialist subcontractor, OEM, or consultancy environment.
  • Strong practical understanding of ductwork and HVAC equipment submittal requirements and approval workflows.
  • Demonstrable experience producing equipment schedules and ductwork schedules suitable for procurement and construction delivery.
  • Solid knowledge of DW144 and SMACNA (fabrication/installation standards and what “good” looks like on submissions).
  • Comfortable interpreting drawings/models and turning them into actionable package scopes.

  • Structured, deadline-driven approach with strong prioritisation across multiple projects/packages.
  • Clear communicator: can write concise technical clarifications and manage client/vendor conversations professionally.
  • Detail-focused with strong revision discipline (submittals live or die on version control).
  • Proactive problem-solver who can unblock RFIs/submittals and keep procurement on track.
  • Good understanding of construction sequencing and the knock-on effect of late approvals.

job.title: Bid Manager
job.description:
Bid Manager
Location: West of Ireland
Salary: €65,000 - €80,000 DOE + Benefits

GI Group is currently recruiting on behalf of a leading organisation for an experienced Bid Manager to join a growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially focused professional who enjoys managing the full tender lifecycle, working with cross-functional teams, and delivering high-quality submissions that secure new business.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership, taking ownership of the complete bid process from opportunity identification through to handover following contract award. You will coordinate internal stakeholders, ensure compliance with client requirements, and produce compelling, commercially sound tender submissions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end bid and tender process, ensuring all submissions are completed accurately and within required deadlines.
  • Produce high-quality, compliant, commercially competitive and customer-focused bid submissions.
  • Coordinate and manage bid teams, bringing together the appropriate technical, operational and commercial expertise required for each opportunity.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships throughout the client and supplier engagement process.
  • Prepare, review and validate the commercial aspects of each bid, ensuring all services and pricing are accurately reflected.
  • Identify, monitor and manage risks and issues throughout the tender process.
  • Contribute to the preparation of written proposals, ensuring both the content and presentation meet a high professional standard.
  • Present and manage bid financial information while ensuring all submissions receive the required commercial approvals before submission.
  • Analyse and resolve technical, commercial and strategic challenges during the bidding process.
  • Coordinate post-bid reviews with customers following contract award.
  • Manage contractual and compliance requirements across all tender opportunities and customer engagements.
  • Ensure a smooth handover of successful projects to the operational delivery teams.
  • Review all bid documentation to ensure full compliance with customer specifications and tender requirements.
  • Continuously assess and improve bid processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Analyse successful and unsuccessful tender outcomes, identifying lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Monitor market trends and undertake data analysis to support future bid strategy and process development.
  • Undertake additional duties as required in line with the evolving needs of the business.


Requirements

  • 5–10 years of experience in similar role.
  • Strong commercial awareness with an excellent understanding of bid and tender processes.
  • Experience managing multiple internal departments and external stakeholders.
  • Good understanding of procurement procedures and tendering processes.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships at all organisational levels and with external partners.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coordinate teams and manage objectives effectively.
  • Highly organised, with excellent planning, prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of the customer journey and the importance of delivering an exceptional client experience.

job.title: Operator
job.description:
Job Title: Operator
Location: Little Island, Cork **Own Transport Required**
Contract Type: 11 Month Employment Contract
Shift: Day Shift (4 x 10 Shift)

We are recruiting for our client based in Little Island to support coating operations in a controlled (cleanroom) environment. You’ll carry out coating, inspection and testing activities, support operators on the floor, and help ensure work is completed on time and to quality standards.
Due to the location of this role, own transportation is required as public transport is not readily available.
This position is responsible for providing hands-on medical device coating services on schedule to meet the requirements of customers as well as providing leadership to the team of Operators by interpreting instruction from Manufacturing supervisors and the Manufacturing Manager, facilitating production and ensuring quality procedures established per ISO 13485. At times, this position may also include administrative, logistic, manufacturing and quality functions as required, e.g. But not limited to Shipping and Receiving, warehouse co-ordination.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform coating, inspections and testing in line with work instructions
  • Support delivery of the daily/weekly production plan and raise any issues impacting output or testing
  • Package both approved and rejected products according to procedures
  • Assist Operators with machine set-up, coating operations and packaging as needed
  • Monitor operator workmanship and machine performance; troubleshoot issues and escalate to Engineering/Management when required
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards and the site Quality Management System (QMS)
  • Receive and inspect customer parts and raw materials
  • Maintain a clean, organised work area (including cleanroom, lab, warehouse and storage areas)
  • Promote good team communication and suggest improvements to processes, equipment, staffing or schedules
  • Support continuous improvement projects (efficiency, quality, cost and revenue opportunities) in collaboration with management
  • Follow all safety policies and support other duties as required

What We’re Looking For

  • Manufacturing experience, ideally in a controlled environment/cleanroom
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Good problem-solving skills (able to identify issues, gather data and recommend actions)
  • Computer skills: Excel, Word, and comfortable learning new systems
  • Knowledge of 5S is an advantage
  • Professional, detail-focused and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Working Environment (Cleanroom & PPE)

  • ISO Class 7 cleanroom environment
  • PPE is required and may include gloves, lab coat, hair/beard covers, shoe covers, safety glasses, hearing protection, face shield and/or respiratory mask
  • Role includes required training aligned to ISO 13485 and relevant FDA regulations, plus internal procedures (as applicable)

Physical Requirements

  • Standing/walking for extended periods
  • Regular bending/stooping/kneeling and reaching above shoulder/below waist
  • Involves heavy lifting up to 50Ibs.
  • May use ladders up to 6 feet

Site Supervisor – Water & Wastewater Civil Projects

Salary: €55k - €70k DOE

Due to continued growth, new contracts and ongoing project extensions, this is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Site Supervisor to take on a key role within major civil engineering and infrastructure projects.

  • Manage labour timesheets, supplier records and relevant HSQE documentation.
  • Ensure all works are carried out in accordance with health and safety requirements.
  • Liaise with project management teams and other stakeholders to ensure effective coordination of works.
  • Identify and address any issues that may affect project delivery.

  • Strong organisational and leadership skills.

job.title: Cost Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Cost Engineer
Reporting to: Financial Controller
Location: Mayo
Salary: €45,000–€55,000 (DOE)
Experience: 3+ years (cost control / project costing ideally within HVAC, MEP, construction, building services, or engineering)
Contract: Permanent, Full-time


Role Overview
The Cost Engineer will support the Financial Controller in controlling and reporting project and operational costs across the HVAC business. This role focuses on accurate cost tracking, margin analysis, forecasting, and cost improvement initiatives to support profitable delivery of HVAC projects and service contracts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Track and analyse project costs (labour, materials, subcontractors, plant, overhead allocations) against budgets.
  • Maintain accurate cost-to-complete (CTC) and cost-to-date reporting for live projects and service contracts.
  • Prepare weekly/monthly cost reports, highlighting variances, risks, and corrective actions.
  • Support month-end close activities related to job costing, accruals, and WIP (where applicable).
  • Assist in project budgeting and set-up (cost codes, baseline budgets, spend profiles).
  • Produce forecasts in collaboration with Project Managers and Operations (including cashflow and margin forecasting where required).
  • Identify cost overruns early and propose mitigation measures.
  • Work closely with Project Managers, Service Managers, Procurement and Stores to validate costs and improve cost capture.
  • Support procurement decisions through supplier spend analysis and pricing comparisons.
  • Assist in evaluating change orders/variations and their cost impact (in coordination with commercial/ops teams).
  • Improve costing processes, ensuring consistent coding, approvals, and documentation.
  • Support audits by maintaining clear supporting files for costs, accruals, and project reporting.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards/KPIs (e.g., gross margin by project, productivity, material usage, subcontractor performance).


Key Relationships

  • Financial Controller (direct reporting line)
  • Project Managers / Contracts Managers / Service Delivery
  • Procurement, Stores/Warehouse, Accounts Payable
  • Senior Management (for reporting and performance insights)


Required Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in cost engineering / cost control / project accounting within HVAC, MEP, construction, engineering, or building services.
  • Strong understanding of project cost structures and margin drivers.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reporting); experience with ERP/job costing systems advantageous (e.g., Sage, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, COINS, etc.).
  • High attention to detail and ability to handle multiple live projects.
  • Confident communicator—able to challenge cost variances constructively with operational teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to work to month-end deadlines.

  • Knowledge of WIP accounting, revenue recognition, or construction/engineering financial reporting.
  • Experience producing Power BI dashboards or automated reporting.
  • Exposure to estimating/tender support or post-project cost reviews.

job.title: Equipment Submission Engineer
job.description:
Salary: €60,000–€75,000 (DOE)
Experience: 5+ years in HVAC / Building Services / Mechanical construction
Reporting to: Pre-Construction Manager
Location: Mayo


Role Summary
This role leads the technical submittal process for HVAC equipment and ductwork packages, turning design intent into procurement-ready schedules and client-approvable technical submissions. You will coordinate across design, estimating, procurement, suppliers, and site teams to ensure technical compliance, timely approvals, and smooth handover from pre-construction to delivery.



Core Responsibilities

  • Validate scope, allowances, and technical assumptions with the Estimating Team during bid and post-award phases.
  • Translate the procurement strategy into a submittal plan (packages, priorities, sequencing, long-lead items).
  • Identify technical and commercial risks early (non-compliance, missing info, programme conflicts) and escalate with solutions.
  • Build compliant submittal packs including datasheets, performance data, drawings, certifications, and technical clarifications.
  • Manage the full review cycle: internal review → vendor review → client/consultant submission → comments → resubmission → approval.
  • Ensure each submission is traceable back to the project specification and drawings, clearly calling out any deviations or alternatives.
  • Drive response timelines with vendors/consultants to keep submissions moving.
  • Interrogate design information (drawings/models/specs) and raise RFIs where gaps or clashes affect procurement or install.
  • Maintain an auditable RFI log with owners, dates, status and impact (cost/programme/technical).
  • Participate in client/consultant coordination meetings, presenting issues clearly and pushing for decisions.
  • Issue “approved for procurement” packs to the Procurement Team with clear scope, approved selections, and constraints.
  • Support purchasing by technically assessing vendor offers for compliance, lead time, access/maintenance and install requirements.
  • Provide ongoing technical support to the Site/Installation Team during installation—resolving equipment/ductwork queries and ensuring the approved solution is installed.
  • Own document control for technical submissions: revision control, transmittals, comment resolution, and approval status reporting.
  • Keep registers accurate and project-ready for audits, handover and O&M inputs.


Experience & Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years’ experience in HVAC/building services within a contractor, specialist subcontractor, OEM, or consultancy environment.
  • Strong practical understanding of ductwork and HVAC equipment submittal requirements and approval workflows.
  • Demonstrable experience producing equipment schedules and ductwork schedules suitable for procurement and construction delivery.
  • Solid knowledge of DW144 and SMACNA (fabrication/installation standards and what “good” looks like on submissions).
  • Comfortable interpreting drawings/models and turning them into actionable package scopes.

  • Structured, deadline-driven approach with strong prioritisation across multiple projects/packages.
  • Clear communicator: can write concise technical clarifications and manage client/vendor conversations professionally.
  • Detail-focused with strong revision discipline (submittals live or die on version control).
  • Proactive problem-solver who can unblock RFIs/submittals and keep procurement on track.
  • Good understanding of construction sequencing and the knock-on effect of late approvals.

job.description:
Position Title: Maintenance Technician
Location: Mayo
Reports To: Production manager
Employment Type: Full time


Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled and proactive Maintenance Technician to join our clients team. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and safety of our production equipment and facilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for performing preventative maintenance, diagnosing and repairing faults, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on a wide range of plant machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance and compliance with safety and operational standards.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical and electrical faults, carrying out timely repairs to minimize production downtime.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all maintenance activities, including work orders, inspections, and repairs.
  • Manage and monitor spare parts inventory, ensuring critical components are available when needed.
  • Prioritize and respond to maintenance requests, supporting smooth and uninterrupted production operations.
  • Apply hands-on skills in basic machining bearing and shaft assembly, and fault diagnosis to resolve technical issues.
  • Collaborate with production and engineering teams to identify opportunities for equipment upgrades and process improvements.
  • Adhere to all health, safety, and environmental regulations and company policies.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience or strong aptitude in machine maintenance, ideally within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Competence in reading and interpreting technical drawings, schematics, and manuals.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in machine maintenance (preferred but not essential).
  • Formal qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, or a related field.
  • Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.

job.title: Senior CNC Manufacturing engineer
job.description:
Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – 5-Axis CNC & CAM Technologies
Location Athlone
Reports To Manufacturing Engineering Manager
Role Type - Full time onsite

Salary - €80,000 - up to €10k additional performance bonus, healthcare

About the Role
We are seeking an exceptional Advanced Manufacturing Engineer to join our growing Engineering team. This is a senior technical role responsible for developing world-class CNC machining processes for complex orthopaedic medical devices.
The successful candidate will be a recognised expert in simultaneous 5-axis machining, advanced CAM programming, machining process optimisation, and manufacturing technology. You will lead the development of highly efficient machining strategies using HyperMILL, implement advanced probing and automation routines, design innovative workholding solutions, and drive continuous improvements in productivity, quality, and process capability.
This is not a traditional CNC programming position. We are looking for a manufacturing technologist who understands machining science, advanced CAM strategies, fixture design, automation, and process engineering, and who is passionate about pushing the boundaries of advanced manufacturing.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced CAM Programming

  • Develop, optimise, and validate complex simultaneous 5-axis CNC machining programs using HyperMILL.
  • Develop machining strategies for complex free-form orthopaedic implant geometries with an emphasis on process capability, surface finish, tool life, and cycle time optimisation.
  • Apply advanced machining strategies including:
    • Barrel Milling
    • Tangent Milling
    • High Efficiency Milling (HEM)
    • Adaptive Roughing
    • Dynamic Milling
    • Rest Machining
    • Tool Axis Optimisation
    • Automatic Feature Recognition
    • Collision Avoidance
    • Multi-axis finishing strategies
  • Develop standardised CAM templates, machining libraries, post-processing methodologies, and programming standards.

CNC Process Development

  • Develop robust machining processes from CAD model through to validated production.
  • Optimise machining parameters including cutting tools, feeds, speeds, toolpaths, coolant strategies, and machine dynamics.
  • Lead machine prove-outs and production process validation.
  • Troubleshoot machining issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and Design for Manufacture (DFM) activities.

Advanced CNC Programming & Automation

  • Develop advanced probing routines using Renishaw Inspection Plus and machine-resident probing systems.
  • Implement probing strategies for:
    • Automatic work offset setting
    • In-process dimensional verification
    • Adaptive machining
    • Tool breakage detection
    • Closed-loop manufacturing
  • Develop CNC macro programs and parametric machining routines to automate repetitive programming tasks and improve manufacturing flexibility.
  • Optimise machine automation to reduce setup times and improve machine utilisation.

Fixture & Workholding Design

  • Design innovative machining fixtures and workholding systems using SolidWorks.
  • Develop modular fixturing concepts to maximise machine utilisation and minimise setup time.
  • Design robust location and clamping solutions suitable for complex simultaneous 5-axis machining.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing and Quality Engineering to validate fixture performance.

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive machining innovation through the implementation of new tooling technologies, machining strategies, automation, and digital manufacturing techniques.
  • Develop manufacturing standards and best practices across programming, tooling, fixturing, and machine setup.
  • Mentor CNC programmers, manufacturing technicians, and engineers in advanced machining technologies.
  • Support capital equipment selection, machine acceptance, and technology development projects.

Essential Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Production Engineering or equivalent technical qualification such a trade of toolmaker with 8 to 10 years of extensive hands on experience.
  • Minimum of 8 years' experience programming and developing simultaneous 5-axis CNC machining processes.
  • Expert user of HyperMILL CAM software.
  • Extensive experience programming complex simultaneous 5-axis machining centres.
  • Proven expertise applying advanced machining strategies including Barrel Milling, Tangent Milling, Adaptive Roughing, High Efficiency Machining, and Dynamic Milling.
  • Strong understanding of machining dynamics, cutter engagement, toolpath optimisation, and machining science.
  • Extensive experience machining titanium, cobalt chrome, stainless steel, and other difficult-to-machine materials.
  • Proven experience developing advanced Renishaw probing routines and machine-resident inspection strategies.
  • Experience developing CNC macro programs and parametric machining solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Siemens, FANUC, and Heidenhain CNC controls.
  • Experience designing machining fixtures and workholding systems using SolidWorks.
  • Excellent understanding of GD&T and precision engineering principles.
  • Proven ability to optimise machining processes for quality, productivity, and process capability.

Preferred Experience
Experience programming and supporting the following machine platforms is highly desirable:

  • DMG MORI
  • Makino
  • Doosan


Experience with the following is also advantageous:

  • Medical device or orthopaedic implant manufacturing
  • ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing
  • Validation (IQ/OQ/PQ)
  • Digital manufacturing and CAM automation
  • Multi-pallet or lights-out manufacturing systems
  • Robotics and machine automation
  • Tool management systems
  • CAD/CAM integration
  • Post processor development and optimisation

Personal Attributes
We are looking for an engineer who is:

  • Passionate about advanced manufacturing technology.
  • Curious, innovative, and driven to challenge conventional machining methods.
  • A strong analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Highly organised and detail-oriented.
  • Committed to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A mentor who enjoys developing the technical capability of others.

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to join a rapidly growing orthopaedic medical device manufacturer committed to engineering excellence and advanced manufacturing technologies.
You will work with state-of-the-art CNC machining centres, advanced CAM software, and cutting-edge manufacturing technologies to produce life-changing medical devices. You will play a key role in shaping our future manufacturing capability through innovation, automation, and continuous improvement while helping develop the next generation of manufacturing engineers.
If you are passionate about advanced 5-axis machining, manufacturing innovation, and technical excellence, we would love to hear from you.
